mapper.select: select g.id as id, g.name as name, g.shownum as shownum, g.status as status from ecology_biz_mobile_group g order by g.shownum, g.id

select t.id as id, cast(t.typecode as varchar(60)) as typecode, t.sourcename as sourcename, cast(t.typename as varchar(60)) as typename, t.ecology_message_groupid as moduleid, t.isdefault as isdefault from ecology_message_type t order by t.id
select g.id as id, cast(g.groupname as varchar(60)) as groupname, g.groupcode as groupcode from ecology_message_group g order by g.id

select t.id as id, t.name as name, t.groupid as groupid, t.moduleid as moduleid, t.messagetypeid as messagetypeid, t.enable as enable, t.enablepc as enablepc, t.enableem as enableem, t.sendmobile as sendmobile, t.isdefault as isdefault, t.agentid as agentid, t.imgurl as imgurl, t.picture_url as picture_url, t.pc_url as pc_url, t.dialogurl as dialogurl, t.em_app_url as em_app_url from ecology_biz_mobile_config t where (t.isshow = 'y' or t.isshow is null) order by t.id
